evidence.quote:
now requires a signed release
manifest before it ships

observations.why: The directive enacts authority-ranking by imposing a mandatory gate condition on all deployments — a rank-based command over what may ship.

evidence.quote: that is the whole reason for the gate

observations.why: Justifies the gate by proportionality — two prior incidents as the cost that warrants the consequence, a cost/benefit framing of the rule.
The bolded gate declaration re-enacts authority-ranking: a requirement stated as a binding condition, the same command crystallized as a rule label.
Extends the gate's jurisdiction across environments — authority-ranking enacted by specifying the scope of the command's reach.
Naming an owner enacts authority-ranking by assigning a single position-holder the rank-based authority over the gate.

mints.name: GateAsMandate
mints.title: a requirement imposed as a binding condition before something may proceed
mints.frame: Is the speaker here enacting authority by declaring a mandatory precondition, rather than merely describing one?
